scopeNote: Single-agency pack: all in-catalog stations are National Rail (Transport for Wales as franchisee, Darwin/OpenLDBWS feed). Unlike South Wales, there is no second network to exclude — TfW operates no separate local rail service in Rest of Wales the way Valley Lines exists in South Wales (report line 3: 'no dedicated local rail operator'). The open gap here is different in kind: whether TfW's real-time data is actually carried through Darwin/OpenLDBWS is UNCONFIRMED (report lines 34, 67, 121-127), distinct from the plain account-level block below. See coverageGaps.
notes: D1 oracle is docs/rest-of-wales-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/uk-wales/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.

city id is 'uk-wales' per the oracle report's explicit C2/C3 instruction (point 1) and docs/uk-architecture.md's region-id table (uk-wales = Rest of Wales). FLAG: South Wales' merged pack used city id 'south-wales', not 'uk-south-wales', even though uk-architecture.md's table lists 'uk-south-wales' — an inconsistency between that pack and the architecture doc. This pack follows its own oracle report's explicit instruction rather than guessing which convention is authoritative; flagged for Jim/Tim to reconcile, not silently resolved either way. See jim-handoff.md.
Hub lock: Wrexham General (WRX). Junction of North Wales Main Line and Borderlands Line; explicitly NOT Wrexham Central (southern Borderlands terminus, lower connectivity). See hazard-pack.md H6.

Three corridors, no inter-corridor through-running within Wales: North Wales <-> Mid Wales routes via Shrewsbury (England); Mid Wales <-> West Wales routes via Swansea/South Wales region. Each corridor is operationally independent within this catalog (report C2/C3 point 4).

National Rail has NO printed route/line map to transcribe (Darwin is a per-station real-time board API) — no 'lines' array is provided, only corridor-grouped station lists. See direction-model-memo.md for the destination+operator model recommended instead.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as South Wales / West Midlands / Greater Manchester / Liverpool City Region / East Midlands / North East / West of England.

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments for Darwin. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution — same open item as every other UK National Rail region. National Rail static GTFS (Transitland) is CC-BY-2.0 UK, confidence 'clear', reference-only. TfW real-time-feed-specific license: confidence 'not found' (report line 127) — no license to summarize because no confirmed TfW-specific feed exists.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Wrexham General is the sole hub lock (report line 78: 'Recommended hub lock'; explicitly 'Do not conflate with Wrexham Central (southern terminus of Borderlands Line, lower connectivity)'). No second-agency shared-hub case exists here (contrast South Wales' Cardiff Central doNotGroup with Valley Lines) — see hazard-pack.md H1/H6.

coverageGaps: National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists.

Transport for Wales real-time feed status for these services is UNCONFIRMED — a distinct gap from the account block above. Report lines 34, 67, 121-127: static GTFS via Transitland is confirmed live, but whether Darwin/OpenLDBWS actually carries live TfW National Rail data, or whether TfW publishes GTFS-RT through any other channel, is not established. Must contact TfW (data@tfw.wales) to confirm before real-time boards can be built, even after the account-level block clears. If unconfirmed, boards stay schedule-only (Darwin static GTFS) or planned-only.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. Confidence: unclear (per oracle report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here.
National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe — no 'lines' array is provided, only corridor-grouped hub/branch station lists. See direction-model-memo.md.
